message.content:
The drive from San Francisco to Los Angeles is roughly 383 miles (≈616 km) along I‑5 N. Under normal conditions—no major traffic, no detours, and a steady speed of about 65–70 mph—the trip takes around **5½ to 6 hours**.  

If you’re traveling during rush hour or on weekends, traffic can add an extra hour or more, especially near the Bay Area and the Los Angeles metro area. Conversely, if you’re on a clear day with minimal stops, you might shave a few minutes off the estimate.  

So, plan for about **6 hours** as a safe average, but keep an eye on real‑time traffic updates if you’re heading out soon.
